# TFScope vs DeepPBS consensus — AF3 folding inputs (full test set)

Fold **protein + dsDNA** with AF3 for each TF's **TFScope** and **DeepPBS** consensus; compare **ipTM** + interface **pLDDT** between the two (the experimental structures already exist as the GT reference — no GT fold needed). Same protein + `GC…GC` flanks; cores length-matched to the highest-IC 10-bp window. `chains` = number of identical protein copies (dimer families fold 2).
